items.title: Tesla Starts Semi Deliveries. Here's The Final Production Target — With No Timeline
items.summary: Tesla will start shipping its new Semi truck to customers this week, company executives said at an event on Thursday.  With the launch of the Semi, Tesla is pushing into a new category of EVs beyond its current passenger sedans and SUVs.  Despite much of the focus on Tesla's efforts to develop Optimus robots, Cybercabs and self-driving tech, the production-line Semi is the first new EV from Elon Musk's company since the Cybertruck's release in late 2023.
